Subject: Renewal paperwork & proposed term/coverage adjustments for BrightCore

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation, I’m sending a first pass at the renewal paperwork and a short summary of the asks BrightCore flagged during the exec call. We want to keep this rolling through the holiday period (your team’s preference) so we can lock pricing and the enlarged capacity by mid-November.

Attached: BrightCore_Amendment_v3.docx (proposed MSA + order form changes), Usage_Summary_Q3.xlsx (current consumption).

Key items we captured:
- Term: your team asked about shifting to a 24-month term with an option to terminate at 12 months for convenience (with 60 days’ notice).
- Capacity: proposed +30% baseline uplift in Exhibit B across inference tokens and dedicated seat-equivalents.
- Pricing: tiered unit pricing in the draft reflects the uplift; we can layer a one-time implementation credit if we sign before 11/15.
- Compliance / evidence: you requested SOC 2 evidence and a snapshot of audit logs for the last 90 days — we can provide redacted logs and the SOC 2 Type II report.
- Indemnity & liability cap: Legal asked whether BrightCore will accept our standard cap (12 months’ fees) or request a higher cap for regulated workloads.

A quick ask: can you confirm procurement’s preferred sign path (DocuSign vs. internal countersign) and any orgs that need legal to review (e.g., Privacy/Data Security team)?

Next steps I’m proposing:
1) We share the redline to the attached amendment (I’ve highlighted the term and Exhibit B changes).
2) If procurement needs a separate SLA addendum or a data processing addendum (DPA), we’ll loop Legal and ship those in parallel.
3) Please send any procurement timelines so we can prioritize the implementation credit approval.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call this afternoon if that helps.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the summary and the draft. Procurement is aiming to complete internal approvals the week of 11/8 if we can get final redlines this week. A few quick clarifications from procurement and security: 

1) Term/early termination: we can do 24 months with an early-termination at 12 months, but procurement wants to define the financial reconciliation on the termination clause (prorated credits vs. fixed break fee). Please propose language.

2) Capacity uplift: confirm whether the +30% baseline is an amendment to baseline committed units (Exhibit B) or a transient burst allocation. We prefer committed for budgeting — if it’s committed, we’ll need a clause about throttling/burst above committed levels.

3) Data/security: our Privacy team needs the SOC 2 Type II report and a 90-day audit-log sample (redacted). Is that something you can attach? If there’s a separate DPA, please include it.

4) Liability cap: our legal has pushed for a higher cap for regulated workloads (proposing 18 months’ fees). If you can share the rationale for your standard 12-month cap, that will help our GC team.

5) DocuSign: procurement prefers DocuSign. I’ll also need the HubSpot deal ID and any internal acceptance emails for our audit trail.

Send the redlined MSA and a one-page summary of the change impacts (pricing + expected go-live) and I’ll circulate.

Thanks,
Lisa
Director, Vendor Management
BrightCore
lisa.tran@brightcore.com

- Capacity: treat the +30% as committed baseline (Exhibit B amendment) but include explicit burst allowances (up to 50% above baseline) with throttling rules and overage pricing schedule.
- Liability cap: Logan — prepare two redline options: (A) standard 12 months’ fees with carveouts for gross negligence/willful misconduct; (B) 18 months’ fees if BrightCore insists — flag what approval path we need for (B).
- Evidence: Mateo — pull the redacted 90-day audit log snapshot and the SOC 2 Type II PDF. I will attach both to the reply to Lisa (redact any customer IDs).
- DocuSign & HubSpot: Kimberly — confirm the HubSpot deal ID and I’ll include the DocuSign envelope once we have the final. Also confirm the implementation credit approval threshold (I have internal approval for up to $25k if sign by 11/15).

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Logan: redline options for liability cap + language for termination reconciliation (EOD 10/31).
- Mateo: SOC 2 + audit logs snapshot (no PII) (EOD 10/31).
- Kimberly: confirm HubSpot deal ID and implementation credit approval (within 2 hours).
- Naomi: consolidate redlines into BrightCore_Amendment_v3.docx and send to Lisa with one-page impact summary (target 17:00 PT).

Let’s keep the replies tight — we want procurement to have a single redline set.

Thanks,
Naomi
